chew over a problem: Before making any big decision, my father likes to chew over a problem quietly for several days.
在做任何重大決定之前，我爸爸喜歡安靜地反覆思考問題好幾天。
chew someone out: The coach will chew us out if we arrive late to practice again this week.
如果我們這週練習又遲到，教練會痛罵我們一頓。
chew the fat: On Sunday afternoons, my grandpa and his old friends sit in the park to chew the fat for hours.
星期日下午，爺爺和他的老朋友們會坐在公園裡閒聊好幾個小時。
bite off more than one can chew: Don't bite off more than you can chew by joining three clubs and taking a part-time job this semester.
這學期不要不自量力，同時參加三個社團又兼一份打工。
chill out: After the final exams, we went to the beach to chill out and forget about school for a while.
期末考後，我們去海邊放鬆，暫時忘掉學校的事。
chill the wine: Mom put the bottle in the fridge for two hours to chill the wine before the guests arrived.
客人到達前，媽媽把酒瓶放進冰箱兩個小時來冰鎮酒。
send a chill down one's spine: The strange noise coming from the empty house at midnight sent a chill down my spine.
半夜從空屋傳來的奇怪聲音令我背脊發涼。
chilling news: The chilling news that a bomb had been found near the school made every parent worried.
學校附近發現炸彈這個令人心寒的消息讓每位家長都很擔心。
be choked with traffic: During the Lunar New Year holiday, the highway to Yilan is choked with traffic, and cars hardly move for hours.
農曆新年假期期間，往宜蘭的高速公路交通壅塞，車子好幾個小時幾乎動不了。
choke back tears: At her grandmother's funeral, she tried hard to choke back tears while giving a short speech.
在祖母的葬禮上，她一邊發表簡短的致詞，一邊努力忍住眼淚。
choke under pressure: He is a great player in practice, but he tends to choke under pressure in important games.
他在練習時是很棒的球員，但在重要比賽中往往會在壓力下失常。
choke on food: Little children can easily choke on food like grapes, so parents should cut it into small pieces.
小孩子很容易被葡萄之類的食物噎到，所以父母應該把食物切成小塊。
choke off supply: The storm destroyed the main bridge, which could choke off the supply of fresh vegetables to the mountain village.
暴風雨摧毀了主要的橋樑，可能會切斷山村新鮮蔬菜的供應。
chop down a tree: Worried that it might fall during a typhoon, my father decided to chop down a tree leaning toward our roof.
我爸爸擔心颱風時樹會倒下，所以決定砍掉一棵傾向我們屋頂的樹。
chop prices: To attract more shoppers, the department store decided to chop prices on all winter clothes by half.
為了吸引更多顧客，這家百貨公司決定將所有冬季服飾大砍價格五成。
chop and change: Our manager tends to chop and change the plan every week, so nobody knows what to do next.
我們經理每週都反覆無常地更改計畫，所以沒人知道接下來該做什麼。
get the chop: If sales keep falling, many workers in the factory might get the chop next month.
如果銷售持續下滑，工廠裡許多員工下個月可能會被裁掉。
rumors circulate: Rumors circulate quickly in a small school, so be careful about what you tell others.
在小學校裡謠言流傳得很快，所以對別人說話要小心。
circulate a memo: The principal asked the secretary to circulate a memo to all teachers about the new school rules.
校長請祕書向所有老師傳閱一份關於新校規的備忘錄。
blood circulates: When you exercise, your heart beats faster and blood circulates more quickly around your body.
運動時，你的心跳加快，血液在全身循環得更快。
circulate among guests: At the wedding party, the bride and groom circulate among guests to thank them for coming.
在婚宴上，新娘和新郎在賓客間走動，感謝他們的到來。
cite a study: In her report, she cited a study showing that teenagers who sleep less usually get lower grades.
在她的報告中，她引用了一項研究，顯示睡得較少的青少年成績通常較差。
cite an example: To support her argument, she cited an example from a famous study and listed the source at the end of her paper.
為了支持她的論點，她舉了一個出自知名研究的例子，並在論文最後列出出處。
be cited for bravery: The young firefighter was cited for bravery by the city and given a medal after saving three children.
這位年輕的消防員救出三名孩童後，因英勇受到市政府表揚並獲頒獎章。
cite reasons: When asked why he quit the team, Jack cited reasons such as stress and a lack of time for study.
被問到為什麼退出球隊時，傑克列舉了壓力和讀書時間不足等理由。
claim responsibility: Two days after the bombing, no group has claimed responsibility for the attack on the train station.
爆炸發生兩天後，仍沒有任何團體宣稱為火車站的攻擊事件負責。
claim lives: The powerful typhoon claimed lives in several villages and destroyed hundreds of homes last summer.
去年夏天，強烈颱風在好幾個村莊奪走性命，並摧毀了數百間房屋。
claim a refund: If the product breaks within a month, you can claim a refund by showing your receipt at the store.
如果產品在一個月內壞掉，你可以到店裡出示收據要求退款。
claim victory: Both candidates tried to claim victory on election night before all the votes had been counted.
兩位候選人在選舉之夜都試圖在所有選票計算完之前宣布勝利。
claim the title: After years of hard training, the Taiwanese team finally claimed the title at the world championship.
經過多年艱苦的訓練，台灣隊終於在世界錦標賽奪冠。
claim compensation: Passengers whose flights were cancelled can apply online to claim compensation from the airline for hotel costs.
班機被取消的乘客可以上網申請，向航空公司索賠飯店費用。
